lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 10 distinct, high-contrast vertical white lines are visible across the torso. Spacing is relatively equidistant across the mid-section, narrowing slightly as they approach the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Several lines exhibit fragmented or dashed topology, specifically the third line from the anterior shoulder and the final two lines on the posterior flank, which terminate as isolated segments.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A small cluster of two high-contrast white spots is visible on the upper posterior flank, positioned mid-way between the dorsal line and the ventral fringe.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: The two spots on the posterior flank align on a near-horizontal axis, though they remain distinct entities without a connecting bridge.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns exhibit a spiral lyrate trajectory, initiating with a posterodorsal vector before curving medially and then laterally towards the tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory-colored apical tip occupies approximately 12% of the total visible vertical length of the primary horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a prominent white dorsal crest extending from the neck to the rump; distinct white chevron between the eyes; three isolated white spots on the cheek/mandible region; white transverse bands on the lower limbs above the hooves.
